exposure: COVID-19 infection at time of delivery
COVID-19 infection at the time of delivery
low birth weight of the newborn
cohort: 308 mother-infant pairs in Spanish maternity hospitals with Baby Friendly Hospital Initiative accreditation
finding: Mothers with mild or asymptomatic COVID-19 infection at the time of delivery were less likely to have exclusively breastfed during their hospital stay than other mothers in Baby Friendly Hospital Initiative-accredited hospitals.
mod_finding: Birth via cesarean section was associated with a lower probability of EBF upon discharge (AOR 5.06; 95% CI 1.62, 15.79).
